:::{#def-equivalence-relation}
#### Equivalence relation

Let $\sim$ be a [relation](functions.qmd#def-relation) on a [set](sets.qmd#def-set) $S$.
The relation $\sim$ is an **equivalence relation**
[@wikipedia_equivalence_relation]
if it is [reflexive](#def-reflexive),
[symmetric](#def-symmetric-relation),
and [transitive](algebra.qmd#def-transitive).

:::
